info.title: StoryShelf API
info.description: REST API for the StoryShelf visual testing platform. JSON endpoints live under /api/v1; HTML pages are served at /.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Create and manage projects (one project is one Storybook).

tags.name: Builds
tags.description: Upload Storybook builds, inspect capture attempts, retry, and delete.

tags.name: Review
tags.description: Approve or reject snapshots, bulk actions, re-diff, build verdicts, the build changeset and review comments.

testing.description: False when the server has no `testing` option: the build is published but never captured or compared.

baseline.description: The build compared with; null for the first build

unchanged.description: Components with the same hash in both builds

created.description: Baselines that did not exist before

202.description: Build created. PUT the Storybook zip to uploadUrl to publish it (and queue capture when testing is on).

post.summary: Record the dependency packages each story uses

200.description: Usage recorded (replaces any earlier report for the build)

202.description: Zip stored. A zip up to maxInlineUnzipSize (default 50 MB) is extracted inline in this request; a larger one is published by a background job. With testing off, the build becomes approved when publishing finishes on the project's default branch (failed if it cannot be published) and stays pending on other branches; with testing on, capture sets the status.

409.description: The build already failed (for example a rejected zip); create a new build

413.description: Upload exceeds the configured size limit, or the zip is over the inline limit and this host (serverless) runs no publish consumer: upload file by file instead (POST /dedup, PUT /content, POST /manifest)

422.description: The inline zip is invalid, unsafe, or exceeds the extraction limits. The build ends `failed`; upload again to create a new build.

post.description: File-by-file upload, step 1 (dedup, content, manifest): needs no zip extraction and works on any host, serverless included. Send the content hashes; the response lists those the server does not hold yet.
File-by-file upload, step 2: store the missing files content-addressed (multipart, or one file with an X-Content-Hash header).

File-by-file upload, step 3: store the path-to-hash manifest. This completes publishing. With testing off the build becomes approved when it is on the project's default branch and stays pending on other branches; with testing on, a capture is queued and sets the status.

200.description: Manifest stored, or the same manifest was already accepted (no-op)

409.description: The build already accepted a different manifest

202.description: Build reset to pending and capture re-queued (new attempt)

409.description: The baseline changed after this diff was computed; re-diff the build or pass force=true

200.description: Open snapshots approved; snapshots with a changed baseline are skipped

post.summary: Approve a story/mode across all browsers

200.description: Every open snapshot of the story and mode approved and each engine's baseline promoted

409.description: A member's baseline changed after its diff; nothing was approved. Re-diff or pass force=true

post.summary: Reject a story/mode across all browsers

200.description: Every open snapshot of the story and mode rejected
Undecided snapshots re-diffed against the current baselines (no re-render). Decided snapshots are untouched.

400.description: Default-branch builds are authoritative and are not re-diffed

409.description: Build has not finished capturing or failed; retry capture instead

get.description: The verdicts reviewers gave the build and what they make of it: each reviewer's latest verdict, the approvals against the project's requirement, and the full history. 404 when the project has review off.

post.description: Give the build a verdict (approver and admin). A reviewer rewrites their verdict by posting again; the newest counts. With `testing` off the verdicts decide the build: `approved` once the project's required approvals are present and no reviewer's latest verdict is `rejected`, `rejected` when any is. With `testing` on the verdict is a sign-off and the snapshot rollup keeps deciding. The verdict is attributed to the signed-in user, or to the user who owns the API token; a caller that is no user (the bootstrap admin token) gets 403, and only an instance with no authentication at all records an anonymous verdict, which counts when the project needs one approval (409 otherwise). 404 when the project has review off; 409 for a failed or cancelled build, while the build is still publishing, or for an anonymous verdict the project cannot count.

get.description: Components the build added, removed or changed against its baseline build (the latest accepted build of its branch, else of the default branch), from the Storybook catalog. A changed hash means the component's stories changed, not that anything looks different. 404 when the project has review off.

post.description: Stops the work of a build that has not finished capturing: its queued jobs (capture, publish and notification jobs alike) end cancelled, running ones are signalled and stop within seconds, and the build ends `cancelled`, a terminal status that a capture finishing late cannot move (retry resets it like a failed build). It raises `build:cancelled` (webhook and notification topic), never `build:failed` or a capture-failed alert. `testing` class. 409 when the build is not pending, capturing or comparing.

200.description: The build's jobs were cancelled and the build marked cancelled

409.description: The build is not in a cancellable state

200.description: List capture attempts for a build (oldest first)
List every log line of a capture attempt (in order)

409.description: The project already has a label type with this key

400.description: A reserved label type cannot be removed

get.summary: List the packages this project consumes from other projects

put.summary: Replace the packages this project consumes from other projects

get.summary: Linked packages a snapshot's story uses

200.description: Usage of linked packages; empty when the build reported none

get.summary: Export baselines as a zip archive
get.description: Streams `manifest.json` (story/mode/browser/branch → file, SHA-256, timestamps) plus one PNG per baseline at `baselines/<branch>/<storyId>/<mode>.png`. Baselines whose image cannot be read are listed under `skipped`.

post.summary: Import (upsert) baselines from a zip archive
post.description: Accepts an archive produced by the export endpoint. The whole archive is validated (manifest schema, path safety, PNG signature, SHA-256) before anything is written; baselines with the same story/mode/browser/branch are overwritten. Requires the approver role.

post.summary: Retry a git channel's current state
post.description: Asks again for the state of the project's open builds on this git channel only. Nothing is sent to chat, email or webhooks. Answers 409 while no public URL is confirmed, and 503 when the open builds could not be looked up.

409.description: The channel is disabled, or notifications are paused until a public URL is confirmed

503.description: The open builds could not be looked up; try again
